transcript: Bhai yeh banda 10 crore kama raha hai har mahine sirf is ek faceless YouTube channel se. Karna kya hai woh sun lo. Sabse pehle faceless.video pe chale jana aur faceless.video pe jaakar start for free kar dena. option milega jiska naam hai viral cloning section. Uske upar click karo aur wahan par tumhe ek preset milega jiska naam hai candy conveyor. Uspe click karo aur apna YouTube channel connect kar do. Tumhara saara kaam ho gaya. Ab jo system hai woh khud hi video generate karega, edit karega aur tumhare YouTube channel pe post bhi kar dega. Poora process chahiye ho to comment kar dena 'process'. Main tumhe poora process ka guide bhi bhej dunga. Tab tak ke liye Jai Mata Di. Milta hoon tumse next video
